en.headline: Ancient Egypt Unveiled exhibition enters final days at Hong Kong Palace Museum
en.dek: The largest display of ancient Egyptian treasures ever staged in Hong Kong closes on 31 August after nine and a half months, featuring 250 objects from seven Egyptian museums and Saqqara.
body: The Hong Kong Palace Museum’s special exhibition Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums is in its final days, with the last admission on 31 August 2026. Jointly organised with Egypt’s Supreme Council of Antiquities, the show has presented 250 artefacts drawn from seven major Egyptian museums and the Saqqara archaeological site.

The exhibition is arranged in four sections covering pharaonic rule, the world of Tutankhamun, recent Saqqara finds and Egypt’s links with neighbouring civilisations. Objects on view include statues, stelae, gold ornaments, mummy coffins and animal mummies, many of which are being shown outside Egypt for the first time.

The museum said the display has been open daily through August with extended hours on Fridays, Saturdays and public holidays until 8 p.m. Special-exhibition tickets are priced from HK$190 for adults and HK$95 for concessions; full-access tickets covering additional galleries are also available. Visitors were advised to book time slots in advance.

zh.headline: 香港故宮「古埃及文明大展」進入最後數天
zh.dek: 本港歷來最大型古埃及文物展將於8月31日閉幕，展出七間埃及博物館及薩卡拉遺址共250件珍藏，為期九個半月。
body: 香港故宮文化博物館特別展覽「古埃及文明大展──埃及博物館珍藏」已進入最後階段，展期至2026年8月31日。展覽由香港故宮與埃及最高文物委員會聯合主辦，展出來自七間埃及主要博物館及薩卡拉考古遺址的250件文物。
展覽分為「法老的國度」、「圖坦卡門的世界」、「薩卡拉的秘密」及「古埃及與世界」四個單元，展品包括雕像、石碑、金器、木乃伊棺槨及動物木乃伊，當中不少為首次於埃及境外展出。
博物館表示，八月期間全日開放，周五、周六及公眾假期延長至晚上8時。特別展覽門票成人190港元起、優惠票95港元，另設涵蓋其他展廳的全通票。博物館建議訪客預先預訂時段。
